newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mixed.

text.p: Spring wheat cash bids were mixed on Wednesday as dealers noted a pickup in farm sales in several Northern Plain locations.
"There has been a lot of grain moving during the last few days," a Minneapolis dealer said. "A lot of elevators are full and have no room left. Farmers still want to haul grain."
He was referring to areas in North Dakota, South Dakota and Minnesota.
He said farmers were moving grain in North Dakota due to a flood threat in the Red River Valley region.
He said the grain was being sold as well as stored or put in a delayed-pricing program. "Farmers are looking at a $4.00 target price basis spring wheat," he said.
A Montana dealer also noted movement. "A lot of farmers want to make room for next year's crop," he said.
